subject: Baseline hygiene: per-row cause column on fail-baseline.tsv + DRIFTED bucket in sweep-diff
description:
From the s359 wrongly-written-off audit (user worry: failed tests misfiled as not-supported). MEASURED s359 against the cold-cache sweep: 650/679 blessed fail rows fail BYTE-IDENTICALLY to bless time; 18 drifted = 8 magic.t tmp-path run-noise + representation drift (REF→SCALAR on array.t:128 from #163-era printing, p-typeglob→GLOB on the ${^LAST_FH} rows, eval.t:107 cause moved from undef-fn to the ANNOUNCED #155 tie refusal — still task-owned); 11 rows unverified (postfixderef/ref/tr crash-file blind spot). No hidden fixables found. Verdict delivered to user: small, bounded, not distorting the gate.

TWO STRUCTURAL CHANGES (fold into #254 or the post-E5 big hunt; also fine as Opus filler):
1. Add a cause/owner column to docs/fail-baseline.tsv (task number or not-supported.md anchor). Mandatory for NEW rows (sweep-diff should reject a new bless without it); backfilling the existing 679 IS the audit — do it family-wise, not row-wise (most rows collapse into known families: pack groups in docs/pack-failure-groups.md, categorized list in docs/test-failures-categorized.md).
2. sweep-diff.pl gains a fifth bucket, DRIFTED: same baseline row (file+testnum+desc) still failing but with a DIFFERENT got/expected than blessed. Informational, not gate-failing — but printed so cause changes surface automatically. Must tolerate the known noise classes: tmp paths embedded in got values (magic.t /proc rows — consider normalizing /tmp/\S+ before compare), and crash-file PARTIALs.
Join script from the s359 measurement is trivial (perl join on file\ttestnum comparing the tail columns) — rebuild it inside sweep-diff.pl rather than keeping a scratch copy.
